hints.title: Three Lane State Array
hints.text: Track the minimum side jumps required to be in lane 1, 2, or 3 at the current position.

hints.title: Obstacle Invalidation
hints.text: When moving to point i, if an obstacle blocks lane j, invalidate lane j by setting its cost to infinity.

hints.title: Sideway Transfer Relaxation
hints.text: Update non-blocked lanes by jumping sideways from the lane with the minimum jump count plus one.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Breadth search over all grid points consumes excessive memory and queue overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A 3-element rolling state array computes optimal transitions in O(n) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate handles obstacle lane invalidation and sideway jump relaxation cleanly.
